{'text': '上週，Apple對OpenAI提起訴訟，聲稱其前員工「為了OpenAI的利益」竊取了商業機密。', 'translation': '上週，Apple對OpenAI提起訴訟，聲稱其前員工「為了OpenAI的利益」竊取了商業機密。'}

{'text': 'As part of the litigation, Apple has reportedly sent letters directly to dozens of former employees who now work at OpenAI.', 'translation': '據報Apple已就訴訟向數十名現於OpenAI任職的前員工直接發出信函。'}

{'text': 'According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued litigation hold notices to roughly 40 former employees.', 'translation': '據《金融時報》報導，Apple已向約40名前員工發出訴訟保存通知。'}

{'text': 'A litigation hold notice is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organization requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. These letters typically specify what exactly must be preserved.', 'translation': '訴訟保存通知是一種正式書面通知，發給個人或機構，要求其保存可能與法律糾紛相關的文件、紀錄及其他證據。這類信函通常會列明須保存的具體內容。'}

{'text': "Apple suspects that the trade secret theft may have extended beyond what was initially named in last week's lawsuit, prompting the move.", 'translation': 'Apple懷疑竊取商業機密的行為可能不止於上週訴訟中初步點名的範圍，故採取上述行動。'}

{'text': "In case you missed it: Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, as well as former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.", 'translation': '溫故知新：Apple的訴訟將OpenAI及io Products列為被告，同時亦點名前Apple員工Chang Liu及Tang Tan。'}

{'text': "You can read more about Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI here:", 'translation': '如欲了解更多有關Apple控告OpenAI的詳情，請按此：'}

  • {'text': 'Apple Sues OpenAI, Accusing Former Employee of Stealing Trade Secrets', 'translation': 'Apple起訴OpenAI，指控前員工竊取商業機密'}
  • {'text': "An Email Mishap Derailed Apple's Settlement Talks With OpenAI Before the Lawsuit", 'translation': '一封電郵出錯令Apple與OpenAI的訴訟前和解談判脫軌'}
  • {'text': "Apple's Lawsuit Reveals How Many Former Employees It Has Working at OpenAI", 'translation': 'Apple訴訟揭有多少前員工現於OpenAI工作'}
  • {'text': "OpenAI Says It Has Seen No Evidence to Support Apple's Trade Secret Theft Claims", 'translation': 'OpenAI稱未見任何證據支持Apple竊取商業機密的指控'}
  • {'text': "OpenAI's Hardware Development Timeline Remains Unchanged After Apple Lawsuit", 'translation': 'Apple提訴後，OpenAI硬件發展時間表維持不變'}

{'text': "You can read the full text of Apple's initial lawsuit filing here.", 'translation': '如欲閱讀Apple初步訴訟文件的全文，請按此。'}
